thesis: The speaker describes leaving a high-pressure career in investment banking and hedge fund management at age 35 to pursue a path focused on psychology, money, and entrepreneurship. He argues that while he enjoyed the intellectual challenge of mastering complex financial instruments like mortgage derivatives, his departure was driven by an inability to tolerate the constant threat of work encroaching on his personal life.
